title: Dragon on Gothic Rooftop
description: A vibrant purple and green dragon with large pink eyes sits perched on a gothic building's rooftop at night, holding a black smartphone in its claws. The dragon has heart-shaped purple scales, bat-like wings, and a long leafy tail, with glowing hearts, social media icons, and the text 'VIRAL CHAIN' and 'STARS 2.1M likes' floating around it against a dramatic red blood moon and dark fantasy cityscape.
prompt: A cute purple and green fantasy dragon with big pink eyes and heart-shaped scales perched on a gothic rooftop at night, holding a smartphone showing a red moon on its screen, surrounded by floating hearts, social media icons, and text reading VIRAL CHAIN and STARS 2.1M likes, dramatic red blood moon in a cloudy orange sky over a dark fantasy city with spires, highly detailed digital painting
